newsitem.title: CANADA: Placer says no change in Cristinas plan.
newsitem.headline: Placer says no change in Cristinas plan.

text.p: Placer Dome Inc said Thursday that a dispute with Crystallex International Corp over rights to the Las Cristinas gold project in Venezuela would not delay Placer's plan to start mine construction there in May.

"We don't have any expectation of a change in that schedule," Placer spokesman Hugh Leggatt said. He said the timetable depended on Placer receiving necessary environmental permits, the official publication in Venezuela of a wholesale tax exoneration for the project and completion of a US$250 million financing package.
But he said it was not contingent "on any other things including this issue" with Crystallex.
Leggatt said Placer was very close to completing its US$250 million financing arrangement for the US$576 million project.
